data.text:
I commit to catching 15 tons today and donating the entire $15,000 directly to the clinic. That completes the $60,000 commitment. My family taught me that caring for this village means looking after our neighbors as well as our lake.

I’ll limit my catch to 7.5 tons next month, then 10 tons once the lake is back at 100. Let’s record today’s catches and donation receipts together, and check the lake’s stock before next month’s harvest so we stay within the recovery cap. This is a one-month emergency exception, not permission to overfish again.
